environment.build: release, opt-level=z, fat LTO, x64 MSVC, stripped

method.accounting: two old/new/new/old series, all 28 timed trials per version/workload retained; first series showed a noisy after run; 100000 observations per workload; allocation and full digest pass untimed
method.log: one old/new/new/old series, 14 trials per version/scenario; 65536 records, 1 application and 1 title in hot-cache fixture; includes dictionary loading and startup synchronization
method.excluded: desktop CPU/RSS, actual shutdown/sleep and service installation/uninstallation; no benchmark implies full-process CPU improvement
